title: SkillEval：基于认知诊断模型学习LLM可解释能力画像
summary: 提出SkillEval评估框架，利用LLM自动发现题目中的可解释技能，并结合心理测量学认知诊断模型（CDM）估计模型各技能水平。在3811个模型、5个基准上验证，生成更校准的能力画像，可提升未见题目预测准确度，并支持LLM路由（降本60%以上）与自适应测试。
summary_en: SkillEval is an evaluation framework that uses LLMs to discover interpretable skills from questions and applies psychometric cognitive diagnosis models (CDMs) to estimate per-skill abilities. Tested on 3,811 LLMs across five benchmarks, it yields more calibrated, informative skill profiles that better predict unseen-item behavior and enable LLM routing (over 60% cost reduction) and adaptive testing.
